notes.subject: וישלם
notes.rationale: lit. 'came off whole/safe' — 'prospered' (KJV) vs 'remained unscathed/at peace'; rendered 'got peace'.

notes.subject: חכם לבב
notes.rationale: read as description of El ('He is wise of heart') as most versions; could be '(El made) heart-wise (the one who hardens)' but that is minority.

notes.subject: mɔgɔ jumɛn
notes.rationale: rhetorical question put to the hearers — who has defied El and come off whole?

translation: A dusukun na dɔnniya don, a barika ka gɛlɛn; mɔgɔ jumɛn ye a ɲɛ da ⟨El⟩ la, o ye hɛrɛ sɔrɔ?
